text:
Maria Chen: Quick q — small runtime config flip landed in main this morning, purely toggles an internal telemetry flag. Does this deserve a patch bump? I can keep it off until next minor if folks prefer.

Kevin Patel: If it's truly no-behavior-change for customers, we usually avoid bumping. But two caveats: (1) if it changes runtime memory layout/ABI even slightly, bump. (2) if deploybot or release scripts rely on buildmeta to detect changes, might need a tag to trigger the release pipeline.

Anita Gomez: Agreed with Kevin. Can we classify as "config-only" in the PR body and add a RELEASE_NOTE so releasebot skips the default bump?

Maria Chen: PR title has "config: telemetry-opt-in" and PR body says docs-only. deploy-bot how does the bump heuristic treat this currently?

deploy-bot: change-diff-summary: config-only flag toggle. test-matrix: unit/integration/pass. build-impact: none. releasebot-bump-suggestion: SKIP_PATCH_IF_CONFIG_ONLY=true. last-tag: v1.8.2+20260320.

Sam O'Neill: We've been bitten before where a config toggle caused downstream image tags to change and some infra tooling expects a patch tag. If we skip bump, we should ensure downstream CI doesn't assume semantic change. Who owns the downstream tag consumers?

Kevin Patel: Good point. If any external consumer pins by semver (not buildmeta), skipping is fine. If they pin exact artifact name that includes generated buildmeta we might need to create a no-op patch that only updates metadata. But I want to avoid noise in changelog.

Anita Gomez: Proposal: adopt a rollforward-backoff policy — config-only PRs default to not bumping, but the releasebot can optionally emit a metadata-only patch tag when a downstream consumer requires it. Add a simple annotation in PR: "releasebot: metadata-patch-request" to opt-in.

Maria Chen: That seems reasonable. How would the metadata-only patch look? Example?

Kevin Patel: Something like: `git tag v1.8.3+meta.20260321` and optionally `v1.8.3` if we must. My preference is to avoid touching the public semver number unless there's behavioural or API effect. So metadata-only tags should live in buildmeta (after the +).

Sam O'Neill: I worry about our tooling that parses tags for rollforward logic — some scripts stop at the + and others don't. We should standardize. Either treat buildmeta as opaque or ensure tooling strips it consistently.

Anita Gomez: Action item: eng-releases to add a small PR to releasebot that documents and enforces this flow: 
- config-only changes default to no semver increment
- releasebot will emit a buildmeta-only tag when requested via PR annotation or when a downstream consumer declares a hard pin
- release notes will still include an entry under "infra/config tweaks" when skipping bump

Maria Chen: Sounds good. Also, what's our rollback window if we do metadata-only patch tags? Do we give ops an automatic rollback policy?

deploy-bot: canary-rollout: 10% for 15 minutes. rollback-threshold: error-rate > 3% or latency P95 regressed by > 40%. auto-rollback: enabled for patch and metadata-only tags unless explicitly disabled.

Kevin Patel: Let's keep auto-rollback enabled. For metadata-only tags it will almost never trigger, but better safe. Also add a short retention in the changelog for these tags: mark them as "meta-only" so release notes aren't noisy.

Maria Chen: Who will own the releasebot PR? I can open it and include the annotation parsing and a short note in docs.

Anita Gomez: Assign to Maria for initial PR. I'll review and Sam can sanity-check downstream CI assumptions.

Sam O'Neill: I'll run a quick sweep of consumers that parse tags and report back by EOD. If none require a real semver bump, we're good to skip.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — I'll hold off merging the runtime toggle until we have the releasebot change in place and Sam confirms consumer parsing. If we need a stopgap, I'll add the metadata-patch-request annotation to the PR.

Kevin Patel: One last note: update the docs snippet for tagging examples so it's explicit. Example we can paste in docs:```
# preferred (no semver change)
# tag kept as buildmeta-only to reflect pipeline run
v1.8.2+meta.20260321

# only bump semver for behavioral/API changes
v1.8.3
```

Maria Chen: Perfect. Closing the thread, will open the releasebot PR and ping when ready. :thumbsup:
